_comment: Declarative liquidity surveillance rules evaluated per (entity, date) against the metrics frame from fr2052a_analytics.metrics.compute_metrics. Edit thresholds/severity/messages here with no code changes. Each rule: id, metric (column), op (lt|le|gt|ge|eq|ne|between|outside), threshold (number, or [low,high] for between/outside), severity (info|low|medium|high|critical), message (template with {metric},{value},{threshold},{entity},{date}), enabled (optional, default true).

rules.message: Approx. LCR {value:.1f}% is below the 100% regulatory minimum (approximation on synthetic data).
Approx. LCR {value:.1f}% indicates severe HQLA shortfall relative to stressed net outflows.
Short-term wholesale funding is {value:.0%} of total wholesale funding, indicating rollover risk.
Insured deposits are only {value:.0%} of total deposits; funding base is flight-prone.
{value:.0%} of secured funding matures within 30 days; concentrated rollover need.
{value:.0%} of subsidiary liquidity/funding cannot be transferred across legal entities.
Collateral required on downgrade ({value:.2f}x HQLA) exceeds available HQLA.
Computed LCR diverges from firm-reported by {value:.1f} pts (cross-check; not meaningful on synthetic S.L.6).
